column1: # truth-second-reader, 2026-09-30. Gemini gemini-3.1-flash-lite, minimal thinking, via ops/truth/gemini-read.sh.
# (a) 1,597 contested-word crops (with hyphen tails), 40 per contact sheet, CHECK prompt, blind: 40 calls.
# (b) each page re-rendered at its dpi and re-cut (cut-crops; page 4's cut differs from the original's, fixed since); one READER-style call per crop: 98 + 3 timeout retries.
# Settled: Gemini agrees with the reader (both halves of a hyphen-joined word; any word of its reading, as contest.py; 24 of the 194 matched inside a multi-word reading).
# Agreement with the check alone is NOT settled, a departure from the item's rule: 227 of those 544 check readings are exactly a word on the
#   same or an adjacent reader line (266 within two lines), i.e. wordcrops.py cut a neighbour and both models read it.
# b: Gemini words aligned per crop (difflib, folded); a disagreement is a replace block of <=3 words a side on a line wholly in the crop.
#   Larger replace blocks (misaligned_block) were inspected on pages 3, 4, 8: column slivers at crop edges and column-order mismatches.
#   At least 6 of the 40 disagreements are Gemini-side hyphen splits, so the rate errs high. Each disagreement on a settled word was read
#   again blind by a fresh Claude check on a wordcrops.py crop, and is contested unless it backs the reader.
# usd is the logged spend at Pro prices (an upper bound), apportioned by calls; $1.1081 in the log with the earlier aborted Pro run, cap $3.
